findings.description: The separator conditional was inverted while moving the join into get_help_spec. The original was `("; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / ")`, and the new code is `("; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / ")`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with secondary opts, e.g. a boolean flag `--shout/--no-shout`. The original code joined with " / " when no slash prefix was used, but the new code joins with "; ". Help output becomes `--shout; --no-shout` instead of `--shout / --no-shout`. Options using a slash prefix such as `/debug;/no-debug` get " / " instead of "; ". The help text changes for every flag with a secondary option, and help-output tests would fail.
